hook_text: 40 newtons plus 70 newtons equals... 30? Welcome to vectors.
clip_script: One-dimensional vectors are added using a sign convention. Choose a positive direction, announce it, and never abandon it mid-solution. Choose east as positive. Then 40 newtons east becomes plus 40, and 70 newtons west — the opposite way — becomes minus 70. Add: plus 40 plus negative 70 equals negative 30. Negative, under our convention, means westward. The resultant is 30 newtons west. The forces opposed each other: forty eastward newtons neutralised forty of the seventy westward newtons, and the thirty left standing are all the trolley ever feels. That is why 110 newtons — the reflex answer — is so badly wrong.
visual_style: Opposing force arrows slamming together over a trolley, force bars cancelling pair by pair until a single 30 N arrow survives pointing west.
mood: Playful disbelief flipping into crisp logic.
pacing: Provocative hook, quick sign-convention walkthrough, satisfying cancellation payoff.
